**Layer matrices.** Each layer acts on the vector (ψ, φ) with φ = ψ′/m*. With q = k/m* (or p = κ/m* for evanescent layers), a propagating layer of thickness d has M = [[cos kd, sin kd/q], [−q sin kd, cos kd]]. An evanescent layer has M = [[cosh κd, sinh κd/p], [p sinh κd, cosh κd]].
